related.title: GAT：鄰居權重與遮罩正規化
related.titleEn: GAT: neighborhood weights and masked normalization
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付鄰接矩陣、度數審核與平滑趨勢表。；3與5吻合，自迴圈與度數一致，排列測試通過。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver adjacency matrices, degree audits and smoothing trends.; Values3/5 match, self-loops agree with degrees and permutation tests pass.
related.difference: 畫中心節點與兩合法鄰居，另加一個非鄰居高logit誘餌；它必被遮罩。；5與8正確，非法鄰居擾動不影響輸出，合法鄰居變化符合.75靈敏度。
related.differenceEn: Draw two valid neighbors and a nonneighbor with a large decoy logit that must be masked.; Results match, nonneighbors have no effect and valid-neighbor sensitivity is.75.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 聚合矩陣D^−1/2(A+I)D^−1/2；兩互連節點加自迴圈後各度2，權重皆1/2。；教學節點值2與4，線性權重1、無激活；第二值改8。；y1=.5×2+.5×4=3；第二值8時y1=5。
鄰居logit為0與ln3時，softmax權重1/4與3/4；只在合法鄰居集合正規化。；教學鄰居特徵2與6；改第二特徵10，權重固定作聚合敏感度。；y=.25×2+.75×6=5；改10時8。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Aggregate with D^−1/2(A+I)D^−1/2; two linked nodes with self-loops have degree2 and weights1/2.; Teaching node values2 and4, linear weight1 and no activation; change second value to8.; y1=.5×2+.5×4=3; changing the second value to8 gives5.

Neighbor logits0 and ln3 yield weights1/4 and3/4; normalize only over valid neighbors.; Teaching features2 and6; change the second to10 while freezing weights for sensitivity.; y=.25×2+.75×6=5; changing to10 gives8.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: LayerNorm：特徵軸與逐樣本正規化
related.titleEn: LayerNorm: feature axes and per-example normalization
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付鄰接矩陣、度數審核與平滑趨勢表。；3與5吻合，自迴圈與度數一致，排列測試通過。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver adjacency matrices, degree audits and smoothing trends.; Values3/5 match, self-loops agree with degrees and permutation tests pass.
related.difference: 畫batch×token×feature張量，圈出每個token的feature軸；禁止把不同token一起歸約。；兩值在1e−8內吻合，平移及批次獨立性成立，歸約軸明確。
related.differenceEn: Draw batch×token×feature and circle each token’s feature axis; do not normalize different tokens together.; Values agree within1e−8, shift/batch invariances hold and reduction axes are explicit.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 聚合矩陣D^−1/2(A+I)D^−1/2；兩互連節點加自迴圈後各度2，權重皆1/2。；教學節點值2與4，線性權重1、無激活；第二值改8。；y1=.5×2+.5×4=3；第二值8時y1=5。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Aggregate with D^−1/2(A+I)D^−1/2; two linked nodes with self-loops have degree2 and weights1/2.; Teaching node values2 and4, linear weight1 and no activation; change second value to8.; y1=.5×2+.5×4=3; changing the second value to8 gives5.

For[1,2,3],mean2 and population variance2/3 give final standardized feature1/sqrt(2/3+epsilon).; Teaching epsilon1e−5,gamma1,beta0; change the final feature’s gamma to2.; y=1/sqrt(2/3+.00001)=1.224735686; changed result2.449471372.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
